title: PsyJev: Psychological Analysis via System-1 Judgment
abstract: arXiv:2610.36689v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-disclosures on the Web support diverse psychological analyses, from recognizing expressed experiences to identifying symptom-relevant information. We study a shared, question-conditioned decision interface for this heterogeneous problem in content analysis. We organize PsyJudgeBench, comprising 13 annotated datasets and 82 questions across six psychological areas, while preserving source-specific criteria and masks for unobserved labels. We introduce PsyJev, a System-1 model that directly produces distributions over answers specified in each request. Joint supervised training establishes the shared judgment function, followed by Judgment-Anchored RLCD (JA-RLCD), which adapts logit-space reward optimization to heterogeneous psychological judgments through balanced supervision, selective retention of correct SFT predictions, and question-group reward optimization. The Qwen3.5-based 2B, 4B, and 9B models achieve 64.33, 66.21, and 67.56

translated_title: PsyJev：基于系统-1判断的心理分析
translated_abstract: 网络上的自我表露内容支持多种心理分析任务，从识别所表达的经历到识别与症状相关的信息。我们针对内容分析中这一异构性问题，研究了一种共享的、以问题为条件的决策接口。我们构建了PsyJudgeBench基准，包含13个标注数据集和涵盖六个心理学领域的82个问题，同时保留了来源特定的评判标准以及对未观测标签的掩码处理。我们提出了PsyJev，一个系统-1（System-1）模型，可直接为每个请求中指定的答案生成概率分布。联合监督训练建立了共享的判断功能，随后采用判断锚定的RLCD（JA-RLCD），该方法通过平衡监督、选择性保留正确的SFT预测以及问题组奖励优化，将logit空间的奖励优化适配到异构的心理判断任务中。基于Qwen3.5的2B、4B和9B模型分别取得了64.33、66.21和67.56的成绩。
tldr: 该论文构建了涵盖六个心理学领域的PsyJudgeBench基准，并提出PsyJev系统-1模型，通过联合监督训练与判断锚定的RLCD（JA-RLCD）方法，将异构心理分析任务统一到共享的问题条件化判断接口下，基于Qwen3.5的2B至9B模型取得了64.33至67.56的成绩。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces PsyJudgeBench, a benchmark spanning six psychological areas, and PsyJev, a System-1 model trained with joint supervised learning and Judgment-Anchored RLCD (JA-RLCD) to unify heterogeneous psychological analyses under a shared question-conditioned judgment interface, with Qwen3.5-based 2B–9B models achieving scores of 64.33 to 67.56.
